title: Air-fryer-adjacent tools: the two supplied links that are not air fryers
why_this_file_exists: The brief supplied five link.amazon URLs. The canonical product register (data/products.json) describes three, all air fryers. The fourth and fifth appear in no earlier pass of this repository. Read live on 2026-11-17 they resolve to meat thermometers, not air fryers, so the register's discipline could not simply absorb them: a thermometer does not belong in an air-fryer comparison matrix, and inventing a fifth row for appliances that measure different things would be the worse error. This file holds them as a second cluster, verified to the same standard, with the pairing rationale stated where a source supports it.
relationship_to_the_air_fryer_register: Not merged into data/products.json and not published in compare.html or the capacity figures. The air-fryer comparison stays apples-to-apples: three appliances, the same spec rows, the same manuals. This cluster gets its own page and its own rows, because the useful comparison here is between two thermometers, and between a thermometer and the appliance it goes with.
editorial_rule_applied: A page whose cells are mostly blank is thin content, and thin affiliation is the failure mode Google's spam policies name (S30). So this pass publishes one comparison page for the cluster rather than two near-empty product pages, and the rows that no official document supports stay in the blank-and-flagged table on the Flagged page instead of as empty product pages.
link_status: Candidate destinations only. The intended product of both links is unconfirmed - see data/product-intent.json (rows PI-04, PI-05), the canonical record after flag F80 retired the parallel file this pass first amended, and published at product-intent.html. This pass's 2026-11-17 reads are recorded there as observed_redirect_target_full, observed_via and reads_2026_11_17_00bc7156. Nothing here may be read as the account holder's intent.

commission_note.text: No commission rate is published for either item. The Standard Commission Income Statement (S3) lists a 4.50% row for "Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive" and a 3.00% row that includes "Home"; both products sit on Amazon pages under Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining, and the rate that actually applies is the one the reporting system assigns to the ASIN's category, which no public document in this register states. The mapping is therefore left open rather than inferred.
